{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the sentinel value in customer_age
print('Count of -1 in customer_age:', (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue format
print('Unique revenue values (first 10):', df['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check status column
print('Unique values in status:', df['status'].unique())

# Check for QA orders
print('Rows with revenue == 999999.99:', (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Note: The 'status' column has 'completed' and 'refunded'. We want only 'completed'.
completed_count = (df['status'] == 'completed').sum()
print(f'Number of completed orders: {completed_count}')"}
